subject: DPA signing & eSign routing for Finovate - subprocessor disclosure
messages:
From: Carla Mendoza <carla.mendoza@finovate.com>

Cc: Legal Ops <legal-ops@finovate.com>
Date: 2028-08-27T09:12:00Z
Subject: DPA: Subprocessor clause & e-sign routing question

Hi Olga,

We're finalizing the DPA redlines on our side and had a couple of quick operational questions before we proceed to signature:

- Subprocessor disclosure: can you confirm the current list of subprocessors and whether Redwood plans to add any new infra subprocessors in the next 90 days? We reviewed the redline in section 3.2 and want to avoid follow-up notices mid-execution.
- eSign routing: our Legal Ops prefers that the customer signs first, then Redwood countersigns. Are you able to accept a DocuSign envelope with a separate signature block for Finance and one for Legal, and then an automatic countersign by Redwood Legal? If some signers require manual review (e.g., COO countersign), please note that in routing.

I'm attaching our annotated redlines for clarity (Finovate_DPA_redlines_v1.pdf). If you can confirm signatory authority and the preferred routing (DocuSign vs AdobeSign), we'll get the envelope prepared.

Thanks,
Carla Mendoza
Sr. Contracts Manager | Finovate Analytics
carla.mendoza@finovate.com
[Attachment: Finovate_DPA_redlines_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Carla Mendoza <carla.mendoza@finovate.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-27T12:30:00Z
Subject: Re: DPA: Subprocessor clause & e-sign routing question

Hi Carla — thanks for the note and the annotated redlines. Quick answers below and next steps.

Subprocessors: our current list is up-to-date; we don't have planned infra additions in the next 90 days that would affect production. I'll attach the canonical list (Redwood_DPA_v3_redlines.pdf) for audit. If anything changes we notify customers per the DPA notice timeline.

Signatory & routing: Redwood typically follows customer-signs-first, Redwood-countersigns workflow. For Finovate (enterprise tier), the default routing we suggest is:
  1) Finovate Legal signature block (required)
  2) Finovate Finance (optional — if required by your procurement)
  3) Redwood Legal (Olga Petrov) - automated countersign where allowed
  4) Redwood COO (manual) — only if the DPA contains changes to indemnity or SLA that exceed exec thresholds

Authority: I can countersign standard DPAs routinely. Marissa is the backup for any escalations above our threshold and will countersign if there's any material deviation.

Two operational points:
- We strongly prefer DocuSign for envelope audit trail and automated countersign routing; AdobeSign is supported but requires manual handling for countersigns (we'll need a POA fax or manual approval step).
- For EU data transfers we'll need to confirm whether you want SCCs appended or prefer an EU Addendum. We can include SCCs in the envelope.

Next steps: Ben, can you create the envelope and include conditional routing for the Finance signer? Carla, if you confirm "Finovate signs first via DocuSign + SCCs", we'll queue the envelope and aim to countersign within 24 hours of completion.

Thanks,
Olga
Head of Legal — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_DPA_v3_redlines.pdf (application/pdf)]

On Tue, Aug 27, 2028 at 12:30 PM Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com> wrote:
> Olga: "I can countersign standard DPAs routinely. Marissa is the backup for any escalations ..."

Hi Carla — looping in a quick signing matrix so we all align on thresholds. Per our internal policy:
- Olga (Head of Legal) can countersign DPAs for standard terms and commercial value up to $500k;
- Marissa (VP Legal) signs if there are escalations or material redlines to liability/SLA;
- For anything that requires COO or CFO signoff we'll flag that as a manual, out-of-band approval and it will delay countersign.

If you're set on DocuSign, please route the envelope to: Finovate Legal -> Finovate Finance (conditional) -> Redwood Legal (Olga) -> Redwood VP Legal (Marissa) only if the clause "exec_approval_required" is toggled.

Attaching a quick CSV that maps signers to thresholds: signing_matrix.csv. Happy to jump on a 15-min call if you want to walk through routing rules.

Best,
Marissa Cole
VP Legal — Redwood Inference

- Recipient authentication: phone SMS code + email verification (we'll add phone numbers to the envelope).
- SCCs: We'll include the SCC attachment so it's appended to the envelope as part of the final signed PDF.

Envelope link (stub): https://www.docusign.com/envelope/0x123456789abcdef

Thanks — Ben
